summary: Russia has significantly increased the intensity of its attacks, utilizing a record number of guided aerial bombs (KABs) and frequent strikes on civilian infrastructure. Russian forces have made tactical advances near Ustynivka and Shakhove. Concurrently, Ukrainian forces are conducting new operations as approved by President Zelensky.
key_points: Russia utilized over 8,300 guided aerial bombs (KABs) during July, marking the highest monthly figure of the war (Source: @UkraineNow/83192).
Russian forces have achieved tactical advances near the settlements of Ustynivka and Shakhove (Source: @DeepStateUA/23719; @DeepStateUA/23720).
A Russian Wildberries logistics hub in the Tula region was destroyed by Ukrainian drones, resulting in a fire covering approximately 300,000 square meters (Source: @eRadarrua/104118).
Russian forces conducted strikes on Ukrainian ports, vessels, and port infrastructure (Source: @tass_agency/388714).
In Sumy Oblast, Russian strikes using six KABs killed two children and a 75-year-old woman (Source: @UkraineNow/83167).
In Mykolaiv, a Russian strike resulted in the death of an 89-year-old woman and injured seven others (Source: @UkraineNow/83167).
A missile strike on the outskirts of Odesa caused three injuries and damage to civilian infrastructure (Source: @UkraineNow/83181).
Russian forces are reportedly conducting encirclement operations against Ukrainian forces in Kyanytsia and Khrapovshchyna in Sumy Oblast (Source: @tass_agency/388721).

sections.executive_summary: Russia has significantly increased the intensity of its attacks, utilizing a record number of guided aerial bombs (KABs) and frequent strikes on civilian infrastructure. Russian forces have made tactical advances near Ustynivka and Shakhove. Concurrently, Ukrainian forces are conducting new operations as approved by President Zelensky.

points: President Zelensky has approved new operations for the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) following meetings with leadership (Source: @UkraineNow/83186).
The SBU claims to have prevented over 50 assassination attempts on Ukrainian military personnel by Russian intelligence since the start of 2026 (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/32161).
In Odesa, a missile strike on a crowded area near a market resulted in three people being hospitalized with moderate injuries (Source: @UkraineNow/83181).
Russian strikes in Sumy Oblast using six KABs killed two children, aged five and ten, and a 75-year-old woman (Source: @UkraineNow/83167).
In Mykolaiv, a Russian strike killed an 89-year-old woman and injured seven people, including two children (Source: @UkraineNow/83167).
A Wildberries logistics hub in the Aleksinsky district of the Tula region was destroyed by Ukrainian drones, causing a fire across 300,000 square meters (Source: @eRadarrua/104118).
Russian authorities reported three civilians were wounded during a strike by the AFU on the Belgorod region (Source: @tass_agency/388722).

Cyberattacks targeting Russian industrial enterprises have been reported, with attackers impersonating federal officials to request information on avoiding UAV/missile threats (Source: @tass_agency/388739).
The Russian Federation continues to conduct strikes against Ukrainian ports, vessels, and port infrastructure (Source: @tass_agency/388714).
Russian forces have advanced near the settlement of Ustynivka (Source: @DeepStateUA/23719).
Russian forces have advanced near the settlement of Shakhove (Source: @DeepStateUA/23720).
Russian forces are conducting operations in Kyanytsia and Khrapovshchyna in the Sumy region, aiming for encirclement of Ukrainian forces (Source: @tass_agency/388721).
Russian forces utilized a group of reactive UAVs in the direction of Kharkiv and Dnipropetrovsk regions (Source: @kpszsu/71520).
Reactive UAV groups were reported moving toward the capital from the north and east (Source: @kpszsu/71534).
Three reactive Shahed UAVs from the Bryansk region were reported over the Chernihiv region (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69795).
Reactive UAVs were reported in the western part of the Chernihiv region moving south (Source: @kpszsu/71572).
Reactive UAVs were reported in the Kherson region heading west (Source: @eRadarrua/104112).
UAVs were reported in the Black Sea waters heading toward the Odesa region (Source: @kpszsu/71578).
Russia utilized over 8,300 guided aerial bombs (KABs) during the month of July (Source: @UkraineNow/83192).
A combined strike involving various types of ballistic missiles and reactive Shahed UAVs was recorded targeting the capital (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69793).
Reactive UAVs were reported over the Kyiv region, including directions toward Boryspil and the Left Bank (Source: @kpszsu/71549; @kpszsu/71543).

sections.threat_assessment: The operational environment is characterized by high-intensity aerial bombardment, specifically the record use of KABs by Russian forces. The targeting of civilian infrastructure in Sumy, Mykolaiv, and Odesa indicates a continued focus on non-military targets. Additionally, the use of reactive UAVs against urban centers like Kyiv increases the threat to metropolitan areas.
sections.regional_response: The Ukrainian government is responding through both defensive and offensive measures, with President Zelensky approving new SBU operations. The SBU is actively working to counter Russian intelligence efforts, including reported assassination attempts on military personnel. Defensive efforts include monitoring and intercepting various UAV types across multiple regions.
sections.intelligence_notes: The use of reactive UAVs and high volumes of KABs suggests a shift in Russian tactical application to maximize destruction. The destruction of the Wildberries hub in Tula demonstrates the reach of Ukrainian long-range drone operations into Russian territory. Cyberattacks targeting Russian industrial sectors regarding safety protocols represent an emerging hybrid threat dimension.
